name: bk_exp06_claims
title: A text-only model's claims are more often true of the prompt than either reader's
caption: 100 readouts per source (25 per WorkspaceBench family, same items), split by a judge model (Gemini 3.8 Flash, T=0) into at most 12 atomic claims each and labelled against the prompt and gold answer (NLA 844, Oracle Lens 675, text-only 587 claims). B: precision = text-true / (text-true + contradicted), 95% bootstrap CI over readouts. The NLA's contradictions are mostly near-miss quotes of the prompt; Oracle Lens's are wrong facts plus 28% unsupported. Caveat: the judge sees the gold answer; agreement with a second judge is kappa 0.72 (5-way), no human labels.

checks.quantity: n claims Oracle Lens at layer 42

notes: Text-only arm = base Qwen3.6-27B given the prompt under the NLA warm-start instruction (data/nla_instruction.txt), sample s0. Codebook precedence: contradicted > restatement > target/latent > inferable > unsupported (claims.py).
